name: Jason Gann
bio: Jason Gann is an Australian-born actor, comedian, writer and producer. He is best known for his role as the title character in the Australian comedy series Wilfred, directed by Tony Rogers, and the U.S. reboot of the same name.

credits.title: The Story of Wilfred
credits.overview: A feature-length documentary charting the history and legacy of Adam Zwar and Jason Gann's cult classic 'Wilfred' featuring interviews with cast and creatives involved in the series.

credits.title: Celestial Avenue
credits.overview: Kath is looking for love in all the wrong places. In Chinatown in the middle of a less than successful blind date, she overhears the soulful Cantonese singing of Ah Gong. Kath is intrigued. Is there more to Ah Gong than meets the eye?

credits.title: Rats and Cats
credits.overview: Rats and cats is a dark, satirical comedy about a fallen star and broken dreams. It is about fame and our culture of obsession. credits.title: The Illustrated Family Doctor
credits.overview: Gary Kelp (Samuel Johnson) is losing the plot. As he edits a medical journal called The Illustrated Family Doctor, his life and his body seem to be falling apart. A black comedy about coping with the modern world, based on the novel by David Snell.

credits.title: Thunderstruck
credits.overview: After a near-death experience, five boys, all devoted AC/DC fans, make a pact to bury their best friend next to the grave of Bon Scott. Twelve years later, having gone their different ways, they come together to fulfill the promise.

credits.title: Gettin' Square
credits.overview: Gettin' Square is about starting over, keeping clean and going straight. Barry Wirth is fresh out of prison and determined to stay on the straight and narrow.
